# Interactive Axolotl Pet

> Axo, a pink axolotl pet made with React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. It blinks, follows the pointer with its head and eyes, and hops with hearts and sparkles when clicked.

- Live page: https://gitguy268.github.io/interactive-axolotl-pet/
- Source: https://github.com/Gitguy268/interactive-axolotl-pet
- License: MIT
